question: Given a VCF file containing somatic mutations from whole-exome sequencing, normalize the variants and calculate the Tumor Mutational Burden (TMB) in mutations per megabase.

files.eval_guideline: Normalized variant records must match the reference in CHROM, POS, REF, and ALT; header lines and INFO-field order may differ.
files.match_reasoning: The filenames are identical and both files are VCFs holding the normalized variants.
files.strategy_reasoning: Normalizing variants (e.g., bcftools norm) gives the same output every time, and the guideline asks for record-level matching on CHROM, POS, REF and ALT, while allowing headers and INFO-field order to differ. That rules out 'exact', which also checks annotation order. Approximate matching with a 0 bp position window and required allele match checks exactly those four fields and nothing else.

files.eval_guideline: Value must be a single numeric value matching the reference within 1% relative absolute error.
files.match_reasoning: The filenames are identical and both files are plain-text TMB results.
